avoid: mixed cyber-neon and cartoon button languages

fontPolicy.implementation: Map these aliases to fonts already bundled in the project during step 01. Do not download or silently substitute a new font.

numberBehavior.fallback: Use a stable-width numeric container for counters that update in place; ordinary static numbers use normal proportional glyphs.
rules: Do not claim tabular digits when the bundled font lacks tnum support.
Do not replace the bundled font during foundation work.
Use fixed-width layout only where changing digit width causes visible movement.
Use dark navy text on bright primary, reward, premium and semantic-color buttons; use light text on dark secondary, ghost and danger surfaces.
Never mix cyan-magenta extrusion with emerald primary buttons.
Only interactive controls receive a visible extrusion.
Do not bake text into button artwork.
Disabled buttons must remain readable and must not resemble inactive tabs.
Primary action labels stay on one line at their defined size and are never auto-shrunk; use concise copy or a wider/full-width layout.
Long secondary actions may use the compact text style or a documented two-line layout. Generic auto-shrink may not go below 0.90.
Information cards use subtle borders, not heavy black outlines.
Selected cards require both color and a check/state icon.
Glow is reserved for rewards, rarity and short feedback moments.
All segmented tabs use the same selected-state construction.
Unselected is not the same as disabled.
Animate the selected indicator rather than flashing the whole control.
Only the current destination may use the primary green active state.
The center Play control becomes neutral when Play is not the current destination.
Every scroll container must include bar height, safe-area inset and 24 dp extra bottom padding.
The first item is fully aligned at rest.
The last item has the same outer padding as the first.
A partial next item is intentional discovery affordance, never arbitrary clipping.
Prefer transform and opacity animations.
Keep ordinary navigation restrained; reserve celebration for rewards and wins.
Respect reduced-motion settings.
Sustain 60 FPS on supported devices.

rasterArt.masterSize: 1024x1024 unless the asset specification says otherwise
rules: Keep all collectible icons inside an 84% safe area.
Use one top-left key light and one soft lower-right rim light.
Do not include text, price, count or state inside art assets.
Do not add generic particles outside the safe area.

interfaceIcons.preferredFormat: SVG through the project's existing SVG pipeline
rules: Use one optical stroke weight.
Use rounded joins and consistent optical bounds.
Do not mix emoji, photo assets and UI glyphs.
Buttons, tabs, cards, badges and input fields must not be fixed-size PNG screenshots.
Use responsive layers and tokens so Turkish labels and all supported phones fit.
Provide icon or label reinforcement for selected, success, error and locked states.
Critical actions and prices must never truncate.
Support screen-reader labels for icon-only controls.
Use Turkish labels consistently; do not mix English item categories into Turkish UI.
Format numbers and dates through locale-aware helpers.
Do not encode visible strings inside image assets.

requiredChecks: No content permanently hidden beneath fixed navigation
No first carousel card clipped at rest
Identical semantic colors and asset files on iOS and Android
Safe-area correctness on notched and non-notched devices
Touch targets remain at least 44 dp
